gcm.purpose: Restore stable Client Workspace reads and load reviewed Findings through a dedicated Proof route.
changeNotes: Reverts the Client Workspace regression introduced by adding client_findings to its query set.
Adds a lightweight get-client-findings read-only route for Proof.
Proof now surfaces the actual D1 error instead of hiding failed workspace reads.
